content: According to Melvin-Koushki's footnote, Ibn Turka states in Nafsat II that five years have passed since he was sent into exile and nine months since he was promised a review of his case at the imperial seat in Herat, and that meanwhile he has appeared at court once or twice a week to no avail.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, pp.199, 207 (per MK fn.105)
